## Current result — READY_FOR_RELEASE_DECISION

The frozen H1 candidate now completes a separate full live semantic closure through the inference client/provider/auth execution path used by the working Instagram Direct agent. The old trusted party count is withdrawn when a current correction updates only peopleText, while a newer grounded count is accepted. This verification made no runtime, prompt, model configuration, evaluator or corpus changes.

Candidate runtime: `3a5620ac797dbda049fc92cf4cadf7c210221b06`. PR head is `a820c340665a81b6f40342107e87b25a286da1bd`; the commit above the runtime is docs/evidence only. Production remains deployed at `9c2a4722fe23bb683ba4d0db39d9e41db16fff72`; the candidate was evaluated in an isolated checkout and was not deployed.

### Working production path

Fresh process/config/source inspection identifies Direct PID 3811592, V2 enabled and native-agent mode off, using createOpenClawModelAdapter and `/usr/bin/openclaw infer model run --local --json --model openai/gpt-6-sol --thinking medium`. A bounded production-event probe at 2026-10-03T23:47:25Z found 14 model-attributed successes in the preceding 12h; latest at15:26:31.819Z reports provider openai/model gpt-6-sol. A post-run probe at 2026-10-04T00:52:01Z confirms the same worker start identity and config/code hashes.

The current filtered environment, absent applicable dotenv files, byte-bound config and sole eligible OAuth profile, together with compiled route-selection modules, bind the OpenAI subscription route `openai-chatgpt-responses` at `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`. The endpoint is derived from these current inputs and source; production event telemetry does not expose it. Successful native receipts report actual model `openai/gpt-6-sol`. Medium was requested; actual effort is not exposed. This verifies GPT-6 Sol inference, not GPT-6.1 inference.

No source-level transport/model mismatch was found against the historical blocked runner. Its frozen timeout 180000ms differs from production's default 120000ms; this run preserved 180000ms. The original two generic exit1 receipts lack native stderr and auth/config snapshots, so their underlying cause remains unknown.

### Separate clean bounded closure

Run `closure-run-20261003T235800Z`: 2026-10-03T23:58:01.835573+00:00 through 2026-10-04T00:51:27.829369+00:00; terminal BOUNDED_LIVE_COMPLETE, driver exit0. Previous partial results are not merged.

| Frozen corpus | Result | HARD | SOFT |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Exact production | 4/4 PASS | 0 | 0 |
| Frozen v3 | 8/8 PASS | 0 | 1 |
| Frozen H1/C2 siblings | 7/7 PASS | 0 | 3 |
| Previously frozen confirmed-H1 supplement | 1/1 PASS | 0 | 0 |

148/148 successful native inferences: 128 primary runtime calls and 20 independent reviewer calls. Provider failures0; infrastructure failures0 within this clean run; case retries0; HARD_FAILURES_TOTAL=0. Four SOFT findings: style 2 and progression 2. One question-classification protocol disagreement is retained separately as telemetry.

Raw traces confirm actual peopleText-only correction withdrawal (siblings1/5), stale-history rejection, valid newer people4 with marker removal, both-open preference retained after private-product selection, and the exact production-derived dialogue outcome. Bounded F1 review checks 91/91 verbatim current-message update spans plus numeric/date parser corroboration; no dedicated F1 live case was present, so this is not an exhaustive F1 score. Frozen historical deterministic F1 controls were not rerun.

### Isolation and independent reviews

The unchanged disposable semantic harness uses synthetic IDs/local SQLite and an injected in-memory delivery stub. No Instagram/Graph send or production conversation, ownership/CAS/dedupe/outbound state is touched. Native auth/config bookkeeping and cache writes were confined to private scratch state with production files mounted read-only. Config/OAuth material inputs match production; the copied local OAuth state was removed after review. PRODUCTION_INFERENCE_USED=yes; PRODUCTION_DELIVERY_TOUCHED=no; PRODUCTION_STATE_TOUCHED=no means this verification performed no production writes; the live service could naturally update its own state.

Luna A independently audited production/failed paths and bound current auth/compiled route inputs. Luna B independently recounted raw native/evaluator evidence and inspected H1/C2/source spans. Luna C verified frozen source/evaluator/corpus/output hashes and unchanged post-run production process/config identity. No review reason to block this closure was found.

Two earlier isolation bootstrap sets remain separate: four CLI cache-permission startup errors before any provider request, zero inferences. The stale nativeTemporaryWrites plan field is disclosed; actual commands use PrivateTmp and a private cache bind. An invalid manually entered audit timestamp is preserved with separate programmatically timestamped correction probes. No failed/incomplete component was relabelled as success.

### Evidence

A compact final summary is committed at `docs/georgia-v2/evidence/direct-peopletext-correction-3a5620a/FRESH_LIVE_FINAL.md`. Raw evidence is retained in the shared operator workspace at `/root/scratch/georgia-pr104-working-path-20261003/fresh-live-evidence`. Clean raw receipts SHA256: `e1f2106fed19e8bc69bf9a521545f64b054419cbefc6c2707d3c3ab5d129734b`. Independent evidence audit SHA256: `a677699067000c98f0943433fce197b7315d8ad863512af5454c331b9e269c95`. Final preservation review SHA256: `8e6a4e8df8b9d33bddd52a9b6f4ef1a8cf40e33b94cd0af05b8f44902be4ea95`.

Evaluator unchanged SHA256: `3313698b2a721ec5a1f8c112f92a1d1eecc8c8b696bbbabcf88f22c0c1d96ce9`. All frozen corpus and case hashes were verified before execution and independently after it. Raw native/case evidence records are separate for each execution set; live/stochastic evidence is not reusable static proof.

[Historical implementation/deterministic results and old incomplete closure](https://github.com/Tiikou/georgia-instagram-agent/blob/64d989f854959e86e69aefde4e34390b4393c452/docs/georgia-v2/evidence/direct-peopletext-correction-3a5620a/RESULT.md) remain historical evidence, not results of this run. Previous baseline failures and partial closure are not erased.

Draft maintained. FINAL_VERDICT=READY_FOR_RELEASE_DECISION. No merge, deploy, restart or code fix performed.
